name: Residencia Temporal -- Family Reunification Subcategory

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national with a family bond to a Chilean citizen or a Residencia Definitiva (permanent resident) holder applies for the Family Reunification subcategory of Residencia Temporal.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage/civil union certificate, birth certificate, or guardianship document proving the family tie.

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or civil union partner, parent, child under 18 (no age limit if disabled), single child 18-24 currently studying, or a minor under the applicant's guardianship, of a Chilean citizen or Residencia Definitiva holder.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/civil union, birth, or guardianship certificate
Disability registry certification (for disabled adult children)
Passport (1+ year validity for applications abroad)

outcome.duration_length: not specified on the fetched page; extensions available by certifying the continued family relationship

sources.title: serviciomigraciones.cl (SERMIG) -- Family Reunification subcategory: eligible ties are spouse/civil union partner, parents, children under 18 (unrestricted if disabled), single studying children 18-24, and wards under guardianship; no income/sponsorship requirement disclosed; holders 'may engage in lawful remunerated activities'

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chile). Modeled PUBLISHED -- directly tier-1 sourced, and notably GENEROUS relative to most family-reunification routes in this dataset: no income or financial-sponsorship threshold was disclosed on SERMIG's own page, and holders may work under ordinary labour terms rather than being restricted like most dependent-family permits elsewhere in this build (Botswana, Jordan). pr_after_months (12) reflects the reduced Residencia Definitiva timeline SERMIG grants for 'family connections to nationals or permanent residents' (see cl_permanent_residence.json).
